title: Cafeteria & Food Truck Services - DLA Susquehanna
description: BLUF: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) NAF Contracting Office, on behalf of the Susquehanna Post Restaurant Fund, has issued Request for Proposals (RFP) NAFUA1-26-R-0005 to award a single concessionaire contract for full-scope cafeteria, catering, 24/7 automated market, and optional mobile food truck services at Defense Distribution Center Susquehanna (New Cumberland, PA). The contract structure consists of a two-year base period (December 1, 2026 � November 30, 2028) with four two-year option periods (up to 10 years total). Concessionaires pay a monthly fee per facility based on the higher of a Minimum Monthly Guarantee (MMG) or a gross sales commission percentage. THE GOVERNMENT WILL NOT PAY FOR THESE SERVICES. Operational Requirements: The contractor will operate two primary facilities supporting a base population of approximately 4,500 personnel: "Darr's Cafe" in Building 430 (breakfast 7:00�10:45 AM, lunch 10:45 AM�1:00 PM, and on-site catering) and the "Inflight Cafe" in Building 2001 (value-priced breakfast 5:15�10:00 AM, lunch 10:45 AM�12:30 PM, and optional 24/7 unstaffed grab-and-go kiosks). Optional services include operating the government-furnished "Grill Fresh" food truck and executing the annual base Turkey Day event. SCA Wage Determination 2015-4225 applies. Mandatory Milestones & Deadlines: Site Visits Completed: No later than October 23, 2026, at 4:00 PM EDT (advance scheduling required). Written Questions Due: No later than October 26, 2026, at 4:00 PM EDT. Proposal Submission Deadline: No later than October 30, 2026, at 4:00 PM EDT. Submission Instructions & Point of Contact: Proposals must include Part I (DA Form 4069, Section B-6 Fee Schedule, financial statements, Section K certs), Part II (Concession Operating Plan), and Part III (Past Performance / 5-year history). Submit proposals electronically in searchable PDF/Excel to Contracting Officer Michael Thompson at michael.3.thompson@dla.mil with the subject line PROPOSAL SUBMISSION - DLA Susquehanna Cafeteria/Catering Operations (Solicitation NAFUA1-26-R-0005), or deliver hard copies to DLA NAF Contracting Office, Attn: Michael Thompson, 8725 John J. description: "National Drinking Water Programs Technical, Engineering, and Administrative Support" (NDWPTEAS) The United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Office of Water (OW) is performing a "market search" for large and small businesses in preparation for a future procurement that is a recompete of Contract 68HERC21D0006. The EPA is also interested to see if small businesses are capable of meeting this requirement. Information submitted in response to this notice will only be used for internal market research purposes, and no feedback will be offered to the interested parties that submit capability statements. The subject acquisition is anticipated to provide support services for the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Office of Ground Water and Drinking Water (OGWDW). OGWDW is responsible for implementing the Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), a law which establishes a mandatory national program to protect public health through drinking water safety. In accordance with the SDWA, the EPA is responsible for developing regulations and policies for national drinking water quality. EPA is required to regulate contaminants that present health risks that are either known to or likely to occur in public drinking water supplies that present a meaningful opportunity for health risk reduction. The SDWA Amendments of 1996, as well as several other statutes and executive orders, require that the EPA conduct thorough characterizations of the costs and benefits associated with these regulations. The SDWA requires EPA to identify potential drinking water contaminants, establish criteria for an unregulated contaminant monitoring program, study and gather information on these contaminants, assess whether they require regulation, and review existing regulations every six years and revise as appropriate. Accordingly, the contractors selected under this acquisition shall provide technical, engineering, and analytical support to the EPA consistent with the Performance Work Statement for efforts related to implementing the Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA). It is expected that this acquisition will be awarded under a full-and-open competition, however market research is still being conducted to determine if there may be small-business set-aside opportunities. The resultant acquisition is anticipated to utilize the Government Services Administration (GSA) Multiple Award Schedule to establish a multiple-awardee Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) for up to three vendors. The ordering period is anticipated to be up to five (5) years with a maximum ordering value of $115M with Call Orders issued on a Time-and-Materials (T&M) and/or Fixed Price (FP) basis. To help determine if this potential requirement may be set-aside for small business concerns, the government is seeking input from the small business community regarding their interest and capability in performing the tasks reflected in the attached draft Performance Work Statement (PWS). Vendors are encouraged to use the questionnaire contained in this notice (See Submission Instructions and Capability Information). The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 541620 �Management and Financial Consulting� with a size standard of $19M. Respondents should provide their size status for the above referenced NAICS code, (i.e. large, small) and whether or not they are a certified hub zone, 8(a), women-owned, small-disadvantaged and /or disabled veteran owned concern. In addition, the EPA reserves the right to set the resulting procurement action aside for small businesses. As a reminder, small businesses are required to perform at least 50 percent of the costs of the contract performance with their own personnel (See RFO FAR 52.219-14) under a procurement set aside for small businesses. The Government will review qualifications based on the vendor�s responses with specific emphasis on the vendor�s ability to perform the Scope of Work described in Twelve (12) capability areas in the draft PWS in Section 4. Information submitted in response to this notice is used for internal market research purposes only, and no feedback will be offered to the entities that submit capability statements. For more information and instructions, please see the attachments included with this announcement.

description: REQUEST FOR QUOTE Crooks Park Cut & Pile Project Bureau of Land Management Colorado - White River Field Office This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation #140DWF27QL001 is issued as a Request for Quotes (RFQ). This RFQ is being issued as a total set-aside for small business. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. Description Quantity/Acre Unit of Issue Unit Price Total CLIN 0010 Crooks Park Cut & Pile 25 Acre $ $ Description: The Department of the Interior (DOI), Bureau of Land Management (BLM) White River Field Office (WRFO) has a requirement for manual cut & pile of pinyon and juniper trees for the purpose of fuels reduction across approximately 25 acres in the Crooks Park project area. Details of this requirement can be found in the attached Statement of Work (SOW), project/ area maps, and shape files. NAICS: 115310 (Exception 2) - Support Activities for Forestry-Fuels Management PSC: F014 - Natural Resources/ Conservation - Tree Thinning Period of Performance: July 16, 2027 - November 15, 2027 Location: The Crooks Park project area is located approximately 20 miles East of Meeker, CO. Please refer to the attached SOW and area maps for more details. ______________________________________________________________________________ The BLM intends to award a firm fixed-price contract resulting from this RFQ using the lowest price technically acceptable (LPTA) source selection method. In order to be considered technically acceptable, the vendor must demonstrate technical capability and capacity to complete the required work in accordance with the SOW and have satisfactory past performance. In accordance with FAR Part 12 (RFO), offerors must include the following information with your quote submission: 1. Technical Capability (Ability to meet the specifications in the SOW - no longer than 5 pages). 2. Relevant Experience (2 projects ongoing or completed by the prime in the past 5 years) 3. Pricing Note: Any contractor submitting a quote must be registered and active in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) at the time of submission and potential award. Please include your UEI and CAGE code with your submission. ______________________________________________________________________________ Questions: Please submit any questions via email to the Contracting Officer for this action, David Farina, no later than Friday, October 23, 2026 @ 2:30 PM MT. Site Visit: Site visits can be arranged on an as needed basis. Please contact the COR, Shane Pfeiffer, at 970-620-6957 to confirm the date/time. The deadline for quote submission shall be Friday, October 30, 2026 @ 2:30 PM MT. Quotes received after the deadline will not be considered. All quotes shall be submitted via email to David_farina@ios.doi.gov.

REQUIREMENTS The contractor shall maintain a quality control system which meets the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q 9858,ISO-9000 / 9001 / 9002 or equivalent. RESPONSIBILITY FOR INSPECTION: Unless otherwise specified, the contractor is responsible for the performance of all inspection requirements as specified herein. Except as otherwise specified, the contractor may use his own or any other facility suitable for the performance of the inspection requirements specified herein. PROCEDURES:The contractor shall prepare and maintain Quality Control Documentation, test and repair procedures, and inspection procedures which shall be made available to the Government for review and approval. The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of the test, repair, and inspection process, as well as the performance spcifications to perform the procedures. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROGRAM PLAN: The contractor shall develop, implement and maintain a Repair Quality Plan in compliance with the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q-9858, ISO,9000 / 9001 / 9002, or equvalent.The plan shall define the specific methods by which compliance with contractual requirements will be assured. All quality assurance data shall be provided to the Government for review and approval upon request. PURCHASED MATERIAL CONTROL: The contractor shall establish and maintain a system of control over purchased material which shall assure that the necessary requirements of this contract are included. in all sub contract agreements. A parts control system shall establish a record of performance for each purchased and internally manufactured part and shall be used to evaluate continued use of the source. The contractors control system shall be in compliance wil either Mil-I 45208A/Mil-Q-9858 or equivalent Quality Quality Assurance Standared.(ISO/AS:9000, 9001, 9002). RECEIVING INSPECTION OF PURCHASED MATERIAL: Purchased items shall be inspected upon receipt at the contractors facility to assure conformance with all requirements of the Technical Data Package (TDP). Evidence of such inspections shall be maintained for Government review at least twelve (12) months following acceptance of the end item. Inspection reports shall be maintained by the contractor. The inspection report shall, at a minimum, include a record of all dimensional data (coordinate/positional), material, finish, and process with appropriate pass/fail criteria, such ascertifications, and actual dimensional readings. FAILURE ANALYSIS AND CORRECTIVE ACTION:All failure analysis and corrective action reports/plans shall be submitted to the Government. NONCONFORMING MATERIAL:The contractor shall establish an effective system for controlling nonconforming material including procedures for identification, segregation, and disposition. CONTRACTOR INTERNAL REVIEW BOARD (IRB):IRB authority is delegated to the contractor for this contract only. The IRB may be used only for disposition of materials exhibiting minor non-conformances, scrap or rework to return a part to conformance with drawings or specifications as authorized by the approved repair procedures.IRB shall not use "AS-IS" disposition. A complete file of IRB actions shall be maintained for review by the Government for concurrance of classification. MATERIAL REVIEW BOARD (MRB):Formal MRB authority for disposition of "AS-IS"and for minor non-conformances is retained by the Government. The contractor shall submit the appropriate request for Variance via the DCMC to the NAVSUP Contracting Officer. title: OVERHAUL AND REPAIR OF SPG-62 ANTENNA AND MK82 GUN AND GUIDED MISSLE DIRECTOR
description: The Government is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a part of market research for the MK-99 Fire Control System (FCS) Program. SPECIAL NOTICE � SOURCES SOUGHT � Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC), Crane Division, is conducting market research seeking industry inputs and interest for the overhaul and repair of the MK81 Director Group�s SPG-62 antenna and MK82 gun and guided missile director and intends to award a 5-year, firm fixed price, competitive IDIQ follow-on contract to N0016424DWP09. Companies with the capability and facilities to provide these types of supplies and services as well as the experience/expertise are invited to submit information pertaining to their capability to fulfill this requirement as requested below. All interested parties may submit company and product literature, a capability statement no longer than 10 [JM1] [MA2] pages, and/or other pertinent information. Cover Sheet, Company Profile, and List of Abbreviations and Acronyms are exempt from the page limit. A detailed proposal is not requested. Responses should indicate sufficient detail for assessment of potential design architecture, strategies and company interest; submissions should be organized as follows: 1. Cover Sheet: Sources Sought number, company name, company address, technical point of contact with the individual�s name, title, email address, telephone number, and date 2. General response information: Are you a Small Business in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations and the identified North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)? If yes, please indicate your designations (i.e. HUBZone, Veteran Owned, Woman Owned, etc.) Please see attached draft statement of work (SOW) for overview of requirements. Responses should, at a minimum, address the following questions: Describe your experience in providing overhaul to relevant top-side radar systems as identified in the SOW. Briefly describe your experience with parts management and inventory control. Include how you ensure parts are protected from pilfering and from being damaged during assembly and shipping. Briefly describe your experience with repairing items identified during post blasting as repairable not beyond economical repair (BER). Also explain your experience in manufacturing parts to replace BER components. Even though the SOW requires the Government to be informed of any process or part changes, your suppliers may change processes without notifying you. What testing and/or monitoring would you perform to ensure products delivered to the Government continue to meet specified requirements throughout contract execution? Can you meet all requirements contained in the SOW through your own company and/or the use of suppliers/subcontractors/teaming partners? How would suppliers/subcontractors/teaming partners be used? Due to the size of these radars the Government would be providing, do you have the necessary facility/warehousing capabilities? Please specifically address the hook height, paint facilities, square footage and facility location. If you identify an issue, how would you propose to mitigate it? Specify whether your facility currently holds Society for Protective Coatings (SSPC) Quality Procedure-1 (QP-1) or QP-3 qualifications and confirm full capability to comply with NAVSEA Naval Ships� Technical Manual (NSTM) Chapter 631, Section 11, and NAVSEA Standard Item 009-32. If your organization lacks these internal qualifications, would you outsource? How do would you mitigate risks to the delivery schedule and manage asset transportation to and from sub-tier vendors? Please describe your organization�s methodology and system for tracking, managing and reporting on Government Furnished Equipment (GFE). Describe your organization's experience in transporting systems of similar size and scope, including your overall strategy for mitigating transit risks to the assets. If your approach involves outsourcing transportation to a third party, detail how your organization will manage the subcontractor to prevent schedule delays and maintain asset security. Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) for this contract is Level 2 (Self) Certification. Is your company�s quality program certified to ISO 9001-2015? If your quality program is not ISO certified, does your quality system meet the following requirements: monitor and control critical processes, continuously improving processes, establish mechanisms for performance feedback and maintain an effective root cause analysis and corrective action system? Review the draft SOW. Identify any requirements which add risk or unnecessary cost to the effort. Provide recommendations for improvement to meet Government requirements in the most cost-effective manner. Provide amplifying information or clarification of any other requirements to support this RFI. Responders may identify Government customers and/or industry customers for whom they have provided radar repair services. The objective is to merge legacy contracts into a single vehicle to secure economies of scale, eliminate duplicative management overhead, and ensure continuous global fleet readiness. Required Capabilities The scope of this effort includes sustaining engineering, program management, logistics, flight test support, training, repairs, reliability improvements, configuration and obsolescence management, system and subsystem software development, and deployed field services. This is a comprehensive requirement to sustain the safety, airworthiness, and operational availability of these critical assets. In order to perform these tasks, respondents must have the following capabilities for the platforms listed above: Demonstrated knowledge of sustaining engineering to include Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE), design, and fleet support for aircraft hardware and software. Demonstrated knowledge in modifications and installation including detailed experience with kit fabrication, prototype development, and the installation of modifications on aircraft and training devices. Demonstrated knowledge in comprehensive lifecycle support for Foreign and Domestic rotary wing aircraft, including the ability to embed Logistics Support Representatives (LSRs) who can deliver on-site logistics and supply chain management, utilization of Technical Service Representatives (TSRs) to assist with life-limited components, special inspections, and incorporation of modifications, and deployment of Field Service Representatives (FSRs) to provide advanced technical assistance, resolving complex maintenance anomalies and acting as a technical liaison for engineering data and technical deficiency reporting. title: USHMM-RFI-2027-MSSP
description: DISCLAIMER / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE:This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information gathering and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or an obligation on the part of the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) to acquire any products or services. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by USHMM to form a binding contract. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) is conducting formal market research to evaluate commercial vendor capabilities, industry pricing benchmarks, federal/commercial labor rates, and available contract acquisition vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS SIN 54151HACS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3/4, SAM.gov) for re-procuring comprehensive Managed Information Technology (IT) Security, Multi-Cloud/DevSecOps Architecture, Network Engineering, and specialized Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) operational activities. The primary objective of this market research effort is to evaluate whether competitive commercial marketplace capabilities exist to: Sustain, support, and execute day-to-day operations across USHMM's existing "As-Is" securityinfrastructure without operational disruption or increased organizational risk. Perform rigorous security architecture evaluations, threat modeling, gap analyses, and complianceassessments against industry-best security and privacy standards (NIST SP 800-53 r5, FISMA, PCI DSSv4.2.1, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, CSF 2.0). Architect and recommend a modernized, cost-effective "To-Be" security state incorporating ZeroTrust architecture, automated orchestration, tool consolidation, and a Government OwnedContractor Operated (GOCO) Security Operations Center (SOC) framework. Execute a seamless, structured transition lifecycle from the "As-Is" state to the "To-Be" operationalmodel within strict schedule and budget parameters. Pricing Benchmarks & Market Rate Expectations Provide feedback on the commercial feasibility of managing this scope under a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP)monthly fee structure. Provide fully burdened hourly commercial labor rates or GSA schedule rates in the Washington, DCMetropolitan Area for equivalent labor categories (CISO, Security Architect, DevSecOps Engineer,Security Analyst, Network/System Engineer). Submission Instructions & Response Format Response Deadline: All responses shall be submitted electronically no later than October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM EDT. Submission Format: Responses must be submitted in PDF or Microsoft Word format, strictly limited to no more than fifteen (15) pages (excluding cover page and labor rate tables). Point of Contact: Submissions and any clarifying technical inquiries must be emailed to Mary Green, USHMM Contracting Officer at magreen@ushmm.org with the subject line "RFI Response - USHMM Managed IT Security & MSSP Services".

title: Request for Information on Combat Boot Sock
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the U.S. Marine Corps Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps (PAE MC) to identify potential sources to provide a Combat Boot Sock. The goal is to provide warfighting capability and mission support in various environments by enhancing foot comfort, durability, and performance for military personnel. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and harvey.walker1@usmc.mil by October 30, 2026 by 5 PM EST. Background: Program Manager Combat Support Systems (PM CSS) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing a high-performance combat boot sock that meets the requirements of Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003. The sock is intended for use with the applicable standard-issue combat boots identified in the purchase description. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to procure any product or service. Description: The Marine Corps is seeking sources capable of manufacturing a durable, reliable combat boot sock designed to provide comfort, protection, and performance during demanding operational use. The sock shall meet the following Salient Characteristics specified in Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003, including, but not limited to, the following key requirements: Sock shall feature an over-the-calf length with cushioning comfort to protect the wearer from hot spots, pressure points, and blisters when wearing combat boots, and they provide graduated compression to promote blood flow from the foot with a non-slip top cuff opening. The foot of each sock includes contouring for the sock to stay in place without bunching, arch support, a gore heel and toe for improved fit, and nylon reinforcement at the heel and toe for durability. A seamless toe closure or a recessed closure with equivalent low profile is used for comfort and durability. Basic Materials. The sock shall contain wool a minimum of 52% wool (no coarser than US 60s (25 microns or finer)), a minimum of 20% nylon, and a minimum of 1% spandex and shall not contain cotton or rayon fiber. Shade. Shall be in accordance with section 3.3 of the Purchase Description Visual shade matching. Shall be in accordance with section 3.4 of the Purchase Description The finished socks shall conform to the requirements specified in table II when tested as specified. **Please refer to Table II. description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY: This program announcement and RFI are for information and planning purposes only. All Government and Department of War (DoW) Contractor personnel reviewing RFI responses understand their responsibility for proper use and protection from unauthorized disclosure of proprietary information. 1. DAF EMIS Background: The objective of the Department of Air Force Emergency Management Information System (DAF EMIS) is to deliver an enterprise software capability natively deployed within the DoW software ecosystems and data platforms. DAF EMIS will automate and accelerate all four core phases of the Emergency Management lifecycle � Preparedness, Protection, Response, and Recovery � across routine operations, natural disasters, and major contingencies. The purpose of the DAF EMIS is to ensure mission assurance, operational resilience, and timely decision support across the Command and Control (C2) continuum and sustain essential operational missions. DAF EMIS will be the U.S. Air Force�s premier, Government-owned software designed to provide real-time emergency response and installation resource management alongside the C2 continuum. See Attachment 1 Area of Interest (AoI) and Attachment 2 Statement of Objective (SOO) for additional requirement details. The Program Management Office (PMO) at AFLCMC/C3C, Kessel Run, is seeking information for a comprehensive innovative solution to decouple and transition installation Emergency Management (EM) capabilities from the current Command and Control Incident Management Emergency Response Application (C2IMERA) system to establish a DAF EMIS. The Government�s requirement is for an enterprise capability providing an integrated EM lifecycle multi-echelon situational awareness, and comprehensive regional infrastructure data. The DAF EMIS will leverage innovative software to automate and accelerate the entire EM lifecycle �Preparedness, Protection, Response, and Recovery� across both peacetime daily activities to include disasters and adversary attacks. This RFI presents a unique opportunity for companies to showcase their product(s) and/or capabilities to meet this requirement. As a portfolio within Kessel Run, C2IMERA leverages industry best practices to rapidly deliver capabilities while posturing for future Information Technology (IT). The PMO is looking for a solution that will meet the needs of our Users across the globe while embracing Agile software development principles, Development Security Operations (DevSecOps), and Lean product management practices to continuously integrate and deliver software capabilities. The PMO embraces a culture of rapid feedback loops, e.g., build, measure, learn, and user-centered design managed by Government-led teams to rapidly develop, produce, and deploy software across the Department of the Air Force (DAF) Battle Network, while continuously iterating and improving upon those software applications. The PMO intends to develop a System of Systems solution leveraging the best of the current fielded C2IMERA capabilities. DAF EMIS will provide a scalable capability to optimize current capabilities of Emergency Management. The DAF EMIS will ensure data-driven tactical readiness, strategic situational awareness, and expedite decision making processes. DAF EMIS will be in Microservice architecture and operate under the shared Maven Smart System (MSS) data platform. This application will directly support Air Combat Command (ACC), Pacific Air Force (PACAF), and/or other Major Commands with installation resource management. The PMO is seeking information on capabilities from Interested Contractors/Vendors to support the subject requirements to facilitate market research and determine the best strategy and approaches for fulfilling user needs and operational requirements. 2. Market Research Approach: Through responses provided to this RFI, and subsequent Market Research Engagements, the Government intends to obtain: 1) Industry�s input and suggestions on refining requirements; 2) Recommendations on the government�s acquisition and contracting approach; and 3) Industry�s capabilities to meet the above requirements. Respondents to this RFI may be invited to participate in further market research activities, including Virtual or In-person Industry Day, Virtual One-on-One activities, Product Demonstrations, and Questions-and-Answer sessions. 2.1. description: The U.S. Department of State (DOS) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI)/Sources Sought Notice for market research in accordance with FAR Subpart 10.002(b)(2)(ii) and FAR Subpart 19.501 to gather industry input about the Agency�s requirement, contractor capabilities, and best practices regarding the Office of Security Management�s Administrative Support Division managing the Construction Security Monitoring Program, consisting of Top-Secret Construction Security *Team Leaders (TL), *Assistant Team Leaders (ATL), Cleared American Guards (CAGs), Construction Surveillance Technicians (CSTs), and *Site Security Coordinators (SSC), referred to herein as Site Security Personnel (SSP). *Personnel selected as Team Leaders, Assistant Team Leaders, and Site Security Coordinators will be derived from the base labor categories of CSTs and/or CAGs. GENERAL INFORMATION Current Contract Information: Incumbent contractors are currently providing construction security services at Department of State facilities abroad. This includes, but is not limited to, professional monitoring of uncleared labor, observation and note taking, reporting of all security violations, site access control, 24/7 presence, material inspection, document control, and assistance to the designated Site Security Manager(s). Contract Type: The Government contemplates award of either Labor Hours, Time and Material, Firm Fixed Price, or a combination of contract types. Estimated Contract Value: $250M Period of Performance: The period of performance of the contract is anticipated from March 15, 2027, through March 14, 2032, with a one (1)-year Base Period and four (4) one (1)-year Option Periods. NAICS Code: The anticipated North American Industry Code System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 561612, Security Guards and Patrol Services. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION The Department of State (DoS) requires the implementation of SSP to support operations at various overseas facilities designed to control unauthorized access to controlled areas, to deter the introduction of unauthorized materials to the compound, site, or building, and to surveil the activities of un-cleared construction workers to prevent the implantation of clandestine surveillance devices or systems into the structure or its surroundings. REQUIRED CAPABILITIES To be considered capable, interested sources must demonstrate the capability to meet all the following requirements set forth herein: Task 1.0 Recruitment of Personnel The contractor shall be capable of recruiting personnel qualified to obtain the necessary security clearance and having the minimal eligibility requirements for each labor category: Construction Surveillance Technicians must have at least five (5) years� experience in at least one, or a combination of construction security surveillance, technical surveillance countermeasures, industrial or government security involving counterintelligence, construction quality assurance, hands-on construction supervisory or significant construction experience, or Military Occupational Specialty (MOS) relating to any of the requirements. Cleared American Guards must have three years� experience as or like a Military Policeman, Marine Security Guard (MSG), or a security watch stander whose duties included the use of alarm systems, metal detectors, x-ray devices and closed-circuit television systems. Team Leaders and Site Security Coordinators must be approved by the CSM Program Office (COR). They will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis by regard to task order solicitation request and requirements. All personnel must be 21 years of age and older. Task 1.1 Personnel Capabilities All personnel must be in adequate physical and mental health; validated by a licensed physician, and be capable of working within construction sites that include, but are not limited to experiencing: hazardous air quality without personal protective equipment (PPE), standing and walking for extended periods of time, navigating terrain that may present the need to climb, withstand slippery conditions, capable of ascending/descending scaffolding up to 75ft, and able to work in inclement weather and harsh environments. All personnel must be capable of reading, (legible) writing, and conveying information in English. title: USHMM-RFI-2027-MSSP
description: DISCLAIMER / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE:This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information gathering and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or an obligation on the part of the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) to acquire any products or services. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by USHMM to form a binding contract. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) is conducting formal market research to evaluate commercial vendor capabilities, industry pricing benchmarks, federal/commercial labor rates, and available contract acquisition vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS SIN 54151HACS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3/4, SAM.gov) for re-procuring comprehensive Managed Information Technology (IT) Security, Multi-Cloud/DevSecOps Architecture, Network Engineering, and specialized Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) operational activities. The primary objective of this market research effort is to evaluate whether competitive commercial marketplace capabilities exist to: Sustain, support, and execute day-to-day operations across USHMM's existing "As-Is" securityinfrastructure without operational disruption or increased organizational risk. Perform rigorous security architecture evaluations, threat modeling, gap analyses, and complianceassessments against industry-best security and privacy standards (NIST SP 800-53 r5, FISMA, PCI DSSv4.2.1, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, CSF 2.0). Architect and recommend a modernized, cost-effective "To-Be" security state incorporating ZeroTrust architecture, automated orchestration, tool consolidation, and a Government OwnedContractor Operated (GOCO) Security Operations Center (SOC) framework. Execute a seamless, structured transition lifecycle from the "As-Is" state to the "To-Be" operationalmodel within strict schedule and budget parameters. Pricing Benchmarks & Market Rate Expectations Provide feedback on the commercial feasibility of managing this scope under a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP)monthly fee structure. Provide fully burdened hourly commercial labor rates or GSA schedule rates in the Washington, DCMetropolitan Area for equivalent labor categories (CISO, Security Architect, DevSecOps Engineer,Security Analyst, Network/System Engineer). Submission Instructions & Response Format Response Deadline: All responses shall be submitted electronically no later than October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM EDT. Submission Format: Responses must be submitted in PDF or Microsoft Word format, strictly limited to no more than fifteen (15) pages (excluding cover page and labor rate tables). Point of Contact: Submissions and any clarifying technical inquiries must be emailed to Mary Green, USHMM Contracting Officer at magreen@ushmm.org with the subject line "RFI Response - USHMM Managed IT Security & MSSP Services".

title: CAMP WOOTEN/STARBUCK LEVEE REHAB
description: 1. BACKGROUND This sources-sought announcement is a tool to identify businesses with the capability to accomplish the work. This is not a solicitation. This notice neither constitutes a Request for Proposal, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. It should not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purpose. Responses to this Sources Sought notice will be used for market research purposes by the Government to make appropriate acquisition decisions. Therefore, no contract award will result from this Sources Sought Notice. The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Walla Walla District, is seeking interested business sources for a levee rehabilitation construction project entitled: Camp Wooten/Starbuck Levee Rehab. Both the Starbuck and Camp Wooten Levee�s are located on the Tucannon River near the town of Starbuck, and Camp Wooten respectively. Both locations are in Columbia County, State of Washington. This will be a firm fixed price construction contract. North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this project is: 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The associated small business size is $45 million. Performance and Payment Bonds will be required. Responses to this Sources Sought Notice should include the following information: A list of current or past projects demonstrating technical experience with work of a similar nature to that listed in the Summary Scope of Work. For each project submitted, provide a brief narrative statement of the work involved, your firm's role in the project, performance period, the dollar value and the completion date. Include a statement detailing any special qualifications and certifications, applicable to the scope of this project, held by your firm and/or in-house personnel. If any of the experience is that of a subcontractor, please specify that information in your response. A reference list for each of the projects submitted in A) above. Include the name, title, phone number and email address for each reference. Provide a statement of your firm's business size (Large, HUBZone, Service Disabled Veteran Owned, 8(a), small disadvantaged, or woman-owned) with regards to the NAICS code listed above. Provide the percentage of work you (as the prime) intend to perform. If you intend to subcontract a major portion of the work (defined as at least 20% of the work), please include this information in your response. Provide a statement that your firm intends to submit a bid on the project when it is advertised. Provide a statement of your firm's bonding capacity. A statement from your surety is not required. CAGE Code and SAM.GOV Unique Entity ID. Companies or individuals interested in responding are invited to submit their information via email ONLY to Nathan Bruce at: nathan.i.bruce@usace.army.mil. All attachments must be provided in either Microsoft Word or Adobe Acrobat PDF format. Responses should be received by 2:00 p.m. PDT, 30 October 2026. PLEASE REFERENCE "SOURCES SOUGHT: Camp Wooten/Starbuck Levee Rehab" IN THE SUBJECT LINE. Respondents will not be contacted regarding their submission or information gathered as a result of this sources sought notice. All responsible sources may respond to this notice and all responses will be considered. Telephonic responses will not be honored. 2. SUMMARY SCOPE OF WORK Starbuck Levee The levee is located on the right levee bank of the Tucannon River in the vicinity of the Kellogg Hollow Road Bridge, Columbia County, Washington, near the town of Starbuck. Flood flows significantly scoured and eroded one site approximately 280 feet upstream of the Kellogg Hollow Road Bridge. Flood fight operations were performed by Columbia County during the flood event. The scour area is approximately 150' long and extends into the crown of the levee. The second damaged area is approximately 550' downstream of the Kellogg Hollow Road Bridge. The downstream site did not receive flood fight operations and is approximately 20' long. Rehab will include reconstruction of levee portions that have eroded and replacement of armoring on the riverward side of the levee portions to restore levees to pre-damage conditions. Camp Wooten Levee The levee is located on the right levee bank of the Tucannon River, Columbia County, Washington, near Camp Wooten, a Washington State Park Retreat Center. One discrete damage site with a length of roughly 160 feet was identified and reported by the inspection team. Damages observed in this area is attributable to scour and erosion of the levee toe. This has left the levee slope vulnerable to further damage. Rehab will include restoration to the as-was condition by reestablishing riverside slope where erosion has taken place and armoring with riprap. This involves re-constructing portions of the levee that eroded away, including the levee toe. USACE expects to award a single contract in December 2026. The expected work window for the Camp Wooten Levee is January 2027 � February 2027, and for the Starbuck Levee between February 2027 � March 2027. The Camp Wooten magnitude of construction is estimated to be between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The Starbuck magnitude of construction is estimated to be between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. All on-site work shall be performed in accordance with the USACE Safety and Health Requirements Manual (EM 385-1-1). The Contractor will be responsible for establishing and managing an effective on-site Safety and Health program in accordance with EM 385-1-1 that will require the development and submission of a comprehensive project specific Accident Prevention Plan for Government acceptance. In addition, the Contractor will be required to develop and submit for Government acceptance an Activity Hazard Analyses, for each phase of work that complies with EM 385-1-1. A Site Safety and Health Officer (SSHO) employed by the prime contractor shall be required for each shift of the contractor's on-site operations. The SSHO shall possess a minimum of 3-years of experience in construction safety on similar projects and shall have completed the 30-Hour OSHA Construction Safety training within the last 5-years. A Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead employed by the prime contractor will choose and install erosion control materials for specific site conditions, as necessary. The Contractor will be required to use the Government-furnished Construction Contractor Module (referred to as QCS) of the Resident Management System (RMS) to record, maintain, and submit various information throughout the contract period. QCS is a Windows-based program that can be run on a stand-alone personal computer or on a network. The Government will make the QCS software available to the Contractor after contract award.

title: Request for Information on Combat Boot Sock
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the U.S. Marine Corps Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps (PAE MC) to identify potential sources to provide a Combat Boot Sock. The goal is to provide warfighting capability and mission support in various environments by enhancing foot comfort, durability, and performance for military personnel. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and harvey.walker1@usmc.mil by October 30, 2026 by 5 PM EST. Background: Program Manager Combat Support Systems (PM CSS) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing a high-performance combat boot sock that meets the requirements of Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003. The sock is intended for use with the applicable standard-issue combat boots identified in the purchase description. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to procure any product or service. Description: The Marine Corps is seeking sources capable of manufacturing a durable, reliable combat boot sock designed to provide comfort, protection, and performance during demanding operational use. The sock shall meet the following Salient Characteristics specified in Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003, including, but not limited to, the following key requirements: Sock shall feature an over-the-calf length with cushioning comfort to protect the wearer from hot spots, pressure points, and blisters when wearing combat boots, and they provide graduated compression to promote blood flow from the foot with a non-slip top cuff opening. The foot of each sock includes contouring for the sock to stay in place without bunching, arch support, a gore heel and toe for improved fit, and nylon reinforcement at the heel and toe for durability. A seamless toe closure or a recessed closure with equivalent low profile is used for comfort and durability. Basic Materials. The sock shall contain wool a minimum of 52% wool (no coarser than US 60s (25 microns or finer)), a minimum of 20% nylon, and a minimum of 1% spandex and shall not contain cotton or rayon fiber. Shade. Shall be in accordance with section 3.3 of the Purchase Description Visual shade matching. Shall be in accordance with section 3.4 of the Purchase Description The finished socks shall conform to the requirements specified in table II when tested as specified. **Please refer to Table II. Sock performance requirement** Deliverables: This is a Sources Sought Announcement / RFI to identify potential sources. Based on responses, the Government may plan for a future acquisition. Interested parties should demonstrate their capability to produce socks meeting the above requirements. The Government may request samples for future evaluation. Submission Instructions: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. This is not a solicitation, and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. Responses are for information and planning purposes only. This Sources Sought Announcement does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. It is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. Further, unsolicited proposals will not be accepted. Funding is not available at this time. description: Cadaver-Based Medical Training & Program Support The Medical Acquisition Support Office � Alpha (MASO-A) has issued a Sources Sought Notice to identify capable vendors that can deliver Human Cadaver - Based Medical Training and Program Support Services for the 44th Medical Brigade stationed at Fort Bragg Army Base, North Carolina. The scope of this upcoming procurement is requiring the contractor to provide human cadavers, medical equipment, Class VIII Supplies, training days, transportation/logistical support, Subject Matter Expert (SME) and cadaver medical training support. Additionally, the selected source will be responsible for administering cadaver medical training and program support. description: SYNOPSIS: #N68335-27-R-1002 TEST SET � ELECTRONIC SEQUENCER Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division - VFC-204 Standup Effort At NOLA The Naval Air Warfare Center, Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) Lakehurst, NJ intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Teledyne Risi, Inc., CAGE: 0EUB8 for the Test Set � Electronic Sequencer hardware components in support of the NAWCAD VFC-204 Standup Effort At NOLA. This order will procure one (1) Electronic Sequencer Test Set. The Electronic Sequencer Test Set eliminates false removal errors for the Navy Aircrew Common Ejection Seats (NACES) ejection sequencer and allows for true failures. This item is used to expand the test tolerance of the TTU-515/E to account for pressure transducer cyclic drift and update the internal electronics to accommodate the fast sequencer. In addition, six percent of the NACES ejection sequencers are currently being rejected during the SDLM servicing and this item will eliminate those failures. Teledyne Risi, Inc., as the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the Electronic Sequencer Test Set, is the only source with the requisite knowledge, technical experience, and production-level data to produce these components. The components being procured are integral to the NACES ejection sequencer systems and are critical to maintaining operational readiness. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate this requirement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 2304(c)(1), FAR 6.302-1 - Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. title: USHMM-RFI-2027-MSSP
description: DISCLAIMER / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE:This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information gathering and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or an obligation on the part of the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) to acquire any products or services. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by USHMM to form a binding contract. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) is conducting formal market research to evaluate commercial vendor capabilities, industry pricing benchmarks, federal/commercial labor rates, and available contract acquisition vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS SIN 54151HACS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3/4, SAM.gov) for re-procuring comprehensive Managed Information Technology (IT) Security, Multi-Cloud/DevSecOps Architecture, Network Engineering, and specialized Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) operational activities. The primary objective of this market research effort is to evaluate whether competitive commercial marketplace capabilities exist to: Sustain, support, and execute day-to-day operations across USHMM's existing "As-Is" securityinfrastructure without operational disruption or increased organizational risk. Perform rigorous security architecture evaluations, threat modeling, gap analyses, and complianceassessments against industry-best security and privacy standards (NIST SP 800-53 r5, FISMA, PCI DSSv4.2.1, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, CSF 2.0). Architect and recommend a modernized, cost-effective "To-Be" security state incorporating ZeroTrust architecture, automated orchestration, tool consolidation, and a Government OwnedContractor Operated (GOCO) Security Operations Center (SOC) framework. Execute a seamless, structured transition lifecycle from the "As-Is" state to the "To-Be" operationalmodel within strict schedule and budget parameters. Pricing Benchmarks & Market Rate Expectations Provide feedback on the commercial feasibility of managing this scope under a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP)monthly fee structure. Provide fully burdened hourly commercial labor rates or GSA schedule rates in the Washington, DCMetropolitan Area for equivalent labor categories (CISO, Security Architect, DevSecOps Engineer,Security Analyst, Network/System Engineer). Submission Instructions & Response Format Response Deadline: All responses shall be submitted electronically no later than October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM EDT. Submission Format: Responses must be submitted in PDF or Microsoft Word format, strictly limited to no more than fifteen (15) pages (excluding cover page and labor rate tables). Point of Contact: Submissions and any clarifying technical inquiries must be emailed to Mary Green, USHMM Contracting Officer at magreen@ushmm.org with the subject line "RFI Response - USHMM Managed IT Security & MSSP Services".

title: USAF Special Operations Forces Technical Data Management, Development, and Provisioning Project
description: The Government is conducting market research to identify capable small-business sources with the expertise, capabilities, and relevant experience to provide technical manual development and revision, technical data management, configuration management support, engineering support services, and AC-130J-only provisioning support for Special Operations Forces (SOF) C-130 aircraft (AC, MC, and HC). AC-130J provisioning support includes; identification and recommendation of spare, repairable, and consumable material requirements; and support for provisioning conferences and Government-approved Source, Maintenance, and Recoverability (SMR) code recommendations. The Government is considering an acquisition strategy consisting of a five-year technical data contract, including one 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods. The contractor would provide technical writing and technical data development support for incorporation into subsequent Technical Order (TO) revisions and updates. The contractor would provide configuration management support, including the policies, procedures, techniques, and tools necessary to: � Evaluate proposed changes; � Maintain configuration status accounting; � Track and document changes; and � Incorporate approved changes into TOs in accordance with applicable requirements. The contractor would provide engineering services, as required, to review, compile, and develop authorized source data into technical data suitable for Government review and approval. The contractor would provide AC-130J-only provisioning support to identify and recommend spare, repairable, and consumable material requirements necessary to support system operation and sustainment; recommendation of SMR codes for Government approval, and participation in AC-130J provisioning and configuration guidance conferences. The contractor would furnish all material, support equipment, tools, and services necessary to perform the required technical data development, technical manual revision, configuration management, and engineering support services, except for items expressly identified as Government-furnished. The contractor would be responsible for providing, utilizing and maintaining, all support equipment and/or software required at their facility or a subcontractor�s facility. The Government currently possesses a specification-control drawing for certain components within the anticipated requirement. The drawing is not a manufacturing (�build-to�) drawing. Lockheed Martin possesses the complete technical data package for the applicable part(s), and the Government does not currently have authority to release, purchase, or provide access to the complete package. Respondents are advised that participation in this market research effort does not guarantee participation in any future solicitation or contract award. title: Request for Information on Combat Boot Sock
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the U.S. Marine Corps Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps (PAE MC) to identify potential sources to provide a Combat Boot Sock. The goal is to provide warfighting capability and mission support in various environments by enhancing foot comfort, durability, and performance for military personnel. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and harvey.walker1@usmc.mil by October 30, 2026 by 5 PM EST. Background: Program Manager Combat Support Systems (PM CSS) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing a high-performance combat boot sock that meets the requirements of Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003. The sock is intended for use with the applicable standard-issue combat boots identified in the purchase description. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to procure any product or service. Description: The Marine Corps is seeking sources capable of manufacturing a durable, reliable combat boot sock designed to provide comfort, protection, and performance during demanding operational use. The sock shall meet the following Salient Characteristics specified in Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003, including, but not limited to, the following key requirements: Sock shall feature an over-the-calf length with cushioning comfort to protect the wearer from hot spots, pressure points, and blisters when wearing combat boots, and they provide graduated compression to promote blood flow from the foot with a non-slip top cuff opening. The foot of each sock includes contouring for the sock to stay in place without bunching, arch support, a gore heel and toe for improved fit, and nylon reinforcement at the heel and toe for durability. A seamless toe closure or a recessed closure with equivalent low profile is used for comfort and durability. Basic Materials. The sock shall contain wool a minimum of 52% wool (no coarser than US 60s (25 microns or finer)), a minimum of 20% nylon, and a minimum of 1% spandex and shall not contain cotton or rayon fiber. Shade. Shall be in accordance with section 3.3 of the Purchase Description Visual shade matching. Shall be in accordance with section 3.4 of the Purchase Description The finished socks shall conform to the requirements specified in table II when tested as specified. **Please refer to Table II. Sock performance requirement** Deliverables: This is a Sources Sought Announcement / RFI to identify potential sources. Based on responses, the Government may plan for a future acquisition. Interested parties should demonstrate their capability to produce socks meeting the above requirements. The Government may request samples for future evaluation. Submission Instructions: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. This is not a solicitation, and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. Responses are for information and planning purposes only. This Sources Sought Announcement does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. It is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. Further, unsolicited proposals will not be accepted. Funding is not available at this time. The United States Marine Corps has not made a commitment to procure any of the items/services discussed, and release of this Sources Sought Announcement should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur cost for which reimbursement would be required or sought. Response to this Sources Sought Announcement is voluntary and no reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this and any follow-on information requests. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Not responding to this Sources Sought Announcement does not preclude participation in any future RFP if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in the SAM.gov website. It is the responsibility of the potential responders to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this subject. RESPONSES: Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by sending responses regarding this requirement to PAE MC via e-mail ONLY to harvey.walker1@usmc.mil no later than October 30, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in response to this notice. All costs associated with responding to this Notice will be solely at the expense of the interested party. Please provide business size (indicate your socioeconomic status), applicable NAICS code, and CAGE code. If you hold a GSA Federal Supply Schedule contract, please identify your contract number. QUESTIONS: Any questions for clarification may be emailed to harvey.walker1@usmc.mil no later than October 26, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions shall NOT contain proprietary or classified information. An unattributed list of questions and answers will be published at the same web location of this Sources Sought Announcement. **Amendment 0001 - attachment uploaded to answer questions**

title: Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapito 2027-2029
description: Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapito 2027-2029 Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapito 2027-2029 (optiovuodet 2030-2032) Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapitopalveluiden puitesopimuksien kilpailutus vuosiksi 2027–2029 + optiovuodet 2030–2032. Optiovuodet voidaan lunastaa erikseen vuosi kerrallaan, tai kerralla 3 vuotta. Hankinta tehdään julkisena puitejärjestelyhankintana neuvottelumenettelyä käyttäen. Hankinnan tavoitteena on, että pienet työt voidaan tilata tilaajan harkinnan mukaan suoraan tietyltä toimittajalta perustuen muun muassa toimittajan osaamisen, resursseihin sekä yleiseen hintatasoon. Puitejärjestely sisältää mm. seuraavat palvelut: - GIS-kojeistojen huollot ja viankorjaukset sekä -selvitykset. - 400 kV erottavien katkaisijoiden käytönaikaiset tarkastushuollot. - Katkaisijoiden avaavat huollot, modifioinnit tai perushuollot, viankorjaukset ja - selvitykset. - Erottimien modifioinnit, viankorjaukset ja -selvitykset. - Kytkinlaitteisiin liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut ja konsultaatiot, kuten uusien kunnossapitoeritelmien kehitys Tilaajan kanssa. Joillekin yllä mainituista palveluista tullaan asettamaan osaamisen minimivaatimukset. Osaamisen kriteerit sekä puitejärjestelyyn sisältyvät palvelut määritellään tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä. Palveluita tilataan tarveperusteisesti. Pienet työt voidaan tilata suoraan puitejärjestelyssä mukana olevilta toimittajilta tilaajan harkinnan perusteella. Suuremmat kunnossapitotyöt voidaan kilpailuttaa niiden puitejärjestelyssä olevien toimittajien kesken, joiden osaamisen kriiterit täyttyvät. Toimittaja voi osallistua puitejärjestelyyn, vaikka ei pystyisi tarjoamaan kaikkia yllä mainittuja palveluita tai täyttämään yksittäiseen palveluun liittyviä osaamisen kriteereitä .,

title: Finland – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Circulating Fluidised Bed (CFB) reactor and Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG) pilot plant
description: Detailed engineering, manufacturing, delivery, installation, testing and commissioning of a 100 kWth circulating fluidized bed (CFB) pilot plant and an attached heat recovery steam generator (HRSG). The CFB shall be capable of combustion, gasification and other reaction modes using different feedstocks and the process gases specified in the technical documentation. The HRSG, located downstream of the CFB, shall operate as a once-through unit for steam generation and hot-gas cooling. The HRSG shall be designed and manufactured in accordance with PED 2014/68/EU using Module G conformity assessment. Detailed technical requirements, operating conditions, preliminary designs and CAD models are provided in the technical annexes of the Call for Tender. The selected tenderer may display its company name on the delivered CFB and HRSG test rigs.

description: Το αντικείμενο της δημόσιας σύμβασης αφορά την κατασκευή κτιριακών υποδομών και τη διαμόρφωση του περιβάλλοντος χώρου του Εκπαιδευτικού Αστρονομικού Πάρκου Όρλιακα (ΕΑΠΟ). title: Bulgaria – Security-type printed matter – „Изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери“ по обособена позиция № 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка включва изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери по обособени позиции, в частта по Обособена позиция 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“ - 2 000 000 бр. холографски стикера и 2 000 000 бр. знак със съответните холограмни реквизити. ​На основание чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, във връзка с чл. 7 от ППЗОП, обособена позиция № 1 с предмет: „Изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери за служебните карти на служителите на МВР" - 60 000 бр., ще се възлага чрез директно възлагане, по реда на чл. 21​, ал. 6 от ЗОП, съобразно прогнозната й стойност от 75 180,00 евро без ДДС. Стойността на обособена позиция № 1 не надхвърля стойността от 79 998,77 евро без ДДС и 20 на сто от общата прогнозна стойност на поръчката, която е 5 995 180,00 евро без ДДС. Съгласно разпоредба на чл. 7, ал. 1 от ППЗОП, остатъчната стойност на поръчката е 5 920 000,00 евро без ДДС. В изпълнение на чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, независимо от размера на остатъчната стойност на поръчката, тя се възлага по реда, приложим към общата прогнозна стойност на цялата поръчка. ​​​​​​​В настоящата обществена поръчка оферта се подава САМО по обособена позиция № 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“. ​​​​​​​Обособена позиция № 1 ще се възлага по реда на чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП.

title: France – Processing and clearing services – Fourniture de chèques emploi service universels (CESU), dématérialisés ou non, aux agents des ministères sociaux.
description: Dans le cadre de la politique conduite pour favoriser les services à la personne – Plan de développement des services à la personne LOI N° 2005-841 du 26 juillet 2005, les ministères sociaux ont mis en place, depuis septembre 2006 le chèque emploi service universel (CESU) préfinancé pour une partie de leurs agents, destinés notamment au paiement : • Du salaire net d'un salarié employé directement dans le cadre des services à la personne ; • De prestations de services à la personne fournies par des organismes agréés ; • Des structures d'accueil de jeunes enfants (crèches, garderies, centres de loisirs…) ; • De structures agréées, habilitées à effectuer, pour le compte de particuliers employeurs, l'ensemble des formalités liées à l'emploi d'un salarié à domicile (recrutement, gestion administrative du salarié, ...) ; • De prestations d'aide à domicile délivrées à ses ascendants par des salariés employés à domicile ou des organismes agréés, si ces ascendants sont bénéficiaires de l'allocation personnalisée d'autonomie (APA). Le CESU est un titre de paiement nominatif à montant prédéfini délivré par les ministères sociaux qui en assurent le financement intégral.

title: Greece – Plumbing materials – ΠΡΟΜΗΘΕΙΑ ΥΔΡΑΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ 2027-2030
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η προμήθεια υδραυλικών υλικών, τα οποία θα χρησιμοποιηθούν από τις υπηρεσίες του Δήμου την τετραετία 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030, ήτοι μέχρι 31/12/2030 ή έως την εξάντληση του ποσού και των ποσοτήτων, εφόσον η προμήθεια εκτελεστεί σε ποσοστό 100%. Η δαπάνη για την παρούσα προμήθεια προϋπολογίζεται να ανέλθει στις 1.189.281,57€, συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ (Προϋπολογισμός χωρίς ΦΠΑ 959.098,04€ + ΦΠΑ 24% 230.183,53€ = 1.189.281,57€) και θα καλυφθεί από τον προϋπολογισμό των οικονομικών ετών 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 του Δήμου Φυλής ως πολυετής δαπάνη (Ποσό απορρόφησης ανά έτος 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 = 297.320,39€). Η παρούσα δαπάνη θα βαρύνει τον Α.Λ.Ε. 025.2410106001. Οι τιμές μονάδας για κάθε είδος που αναγράφονται στον ενδεικτικό προϋπολογισμό της παρούσας μελέτης, εκτιμήθηκαν με βάση την έρευνα αγοράς από το ελεύθερο εμπόριο και λαμβάνοντας υπόψιν και σχετικούς διαγωνισμούς που έχει διεξάγει ο δήμος τα προηγούμενα έτη. Η αναγκαιότητα της εν λόγω σύμβασης προκύπτει από τις αυξημένες ανάγκες των υπηρεσιών του δήμου για την ως άνω προμήθεια, μετά και την κατάργηση των νομικών προσώπων των Ο.Τ.Α. (Νόμος 5056/2023, ΦΕΚ Α 163/6.10.2023). Οι ποσότητες της προηγούμενης υπογραφείσας σχετικής σύμβασης για τα έτη 2025-2026 έχουν σχεδόν εξαντληθεί ήδη με αποτέλεσμα την άμεση ολοκλήρωση της σύμβασης αυτής. Έτσι δημιουργήθηκε η αναγκαιότητα πρόσθετων ποσοτήτων για τα έτη 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 που αναμένεται να καλυφθεί με την εν λόγω διαδικασία. Οι ποσότητες των υδραυλικών υλικών που αναφέρονται στον Πίνακα Ενδεικτικού Προϋπολογισμού της παρούσας μελέτης είναι αμιγώς ενδεικτικές και όχι δεσμευτικές για την αναθέτουσα αρχή. Η εκτέλεση της προμήθειας και η ανάλωση των ειδών θα πραγματοποιούνται τμηματικά, ανάλογα με τις πραγματικές ανάγκες και κατόπιν παραγγελιών των αρμόδιων υπηρεσιών του Δήμου Φυλής, οι οποίες θα εξαρτώνται από τις εκάστοτε παρουσιαζόμενες ανάγκες συντήρησης και αποκατάστασης των δικτύων. Ο Δήμος Φυλής διατηρεί το δικαίωμα να μην εξαντλήσει το σύνολο των ενδεικτικών ποσοτήτων ή του προϋπολογισμού κατά τη διάρκεια της τετραετούς σύμβασης. Οι τελικές ποσότητες των υλικών που θα παραγγελθούν ενδέχεται να είναι μικρότερες των προϋπολογισθέντων, ανάλογα με τις πραγματικές ανάγκες των αρμόδιων υπηρεσιών. Ο ανάδοχος δεν διατηρεί καμία αξίωση για αποζημίωση ή διαφυγόντα κέρδη σε περίπτωση που η απορρόφηση υπολείπεται του αρχικού ενδεικτικού προϋπολογισμού. Η προμήθεια κατατάσσεται στους Κωδικούς Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 44115210-4 Υλικά υδραυλικών εγκαταστάσεων Η εκτέλεση της παραπάνω προμήθειας θα γίνει με την διενέργεια δημόσιου ηλεκτρονικού διαγωνισμού άνω των ορίων και με κριτήριο κατακύρωσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει τιμής σύμφωνα με τις διατάξεις του Ν.4412/2016 όπως τροποποιήθηκαν και ισχύουν, για το σύνολο των προς προμήθεια ειδών. Η παρούσα προμήθεια δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται για το σύνολο των παραπάνω ειδών. Η διάρκεια υλοποίησης της προμήθειας ορίζεται από την υπογραφή της σύμβασης για την τετραετία 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030, ήτοι μέχρι 31/12/2030 ή έως την εξάντληση του ποσού και των ποσοτήτων,εφόσον η προμήθεια εκτελεστεί σε ποσοστό 100%. Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στην υπ’ αριθμ. 160/2026 μελέτη της υπηρεσίας. Η σύμβαση μπορεί να τροποποιείται κατά τη διάρκειά της, χωρίς να απαιτείται νέα διαδικασία σύναψης σύμβασης, μόνο σύμφωνα με τους όρους και τις προϋποθέσεις του άρθρου 132 του ν. 4412/2016 και κατόπιν γνωμοδότησης της καθ’ ύλην αρμόδιας υπηρεσίας ή άλλως της υπηρεσίας η οποία ορίζεται με απόφαση της Α.Α. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της τιμής.

title: IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut ajalle 1.11.2022 (tavoite) - 31.10.2026
description: Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kohteena on IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut Turun kaupungin asiakkaille. DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä "Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohde". Tilaaja täsmentää ja kuvaa hankintatarpeensa tarkemmin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen kilpailutuksen tarjouspyynnöissään. DPS:ään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Kaikki hakijoille asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät hakijat hyväksytään osallistumaan DPS:ssään. Hankinnat tehdään DPS:n sisällä erillisillä tarjouspyynnöillä. DPS:n kohteena on IT-asiantuntijatyö. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteeseen kuuluvat seuraavat palvelut: 1) IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut sekä lisenssit 2) IT-omaisuuden hallinta 3) Tietoturva ja tietosuoja 4) Määrittely ja jatkuvuussuunnittelu 5) Sovellus- ja ohjelmistokehitys ja ylläpito 6) Alustapalvelut ja lisenssit 7) Toteutuksen arkkitehtuuri DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. Turun kaupungin asiantuntijat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen arviolta 15.11.2022 ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä.

title: Industry Day - Industry Engagement for Long-Term Fire Retardant Specification Revision
description: USDA Forest Service � Fire & Aviation Management Industry Engagement Notice: Long-Term Fire Retardant Specification Revision Event Date: November 10, 2026 Event Time: Start time TBD. All activities are expected to be completed by no later than 17:00 local (mountain) time. Location: In-Person: Jack Wilson Building, National Interagency Fire Center, Boise, ID / Virtual Option: Link will be emailed to registered attendees in advance. Reasonable accommodations will be made to participate in the event for interested parties. This includes a virtual option to listen in, be sure to register in advance. Overview: The USDA Forest Service Fire and Aviation Management will host an Industry Engagement session focusing on the revision and updates to the long-term fire retardant specification (FS 5100-304e) and the associated standard test procedures. These revisions are being made in response to issues identified during the qualification process by the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB). This session is not a solicitation, and is intended solely for engagement and conversation around the new criteria. Industry feedback collected in Spring 2026 has already been incorporated into the revision. A copy of the revised specification will be emailed to all registered attendees prior to the event. Registration: Registration is required for interested parties for both in-person and virtual attendance. Indicate your response in the attached document containing a link and/or QR code for the registration form. Registration is limited to 3 participants per company. Final attendance details will be emailed to in-person and virtual participants in advance of the engagement. Attachments related to the engagement will also be emailed to registered attendees in advance. Disclaimers: This event is for interested parties to the FS 5100-304e specification only; This is not a solicitation; Participation does not imply preference for future awards; No cost reimbursement is authorized.

title: Chemical and Electric Propulsion Systems (Pre-RFI Market Research)
description: The Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is reviewing options to find Small Businesses and/or Small Business Joint Ventures or Teams led by a Small Businesses with experience performing the below scope tasks. JPL is seeking information from qualified small businesses with demonstrated experience supporting spacecraft chemical and electric propulsion systems throughout the design, development, integration, test, qualification, and flight-readiness lifecycle. Relevant capabilities may include propulsion system architecture and requirements, thruster and feed-system design, propulsion subsystem engineering, modeling and simulation, power processing and propellant systems, hardware fabrication and assembly support, environmental and performance testing, failure analysis, and verification. title: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel
description: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel Beskrivelse (dansk): Beredskabsstyrelsen ("BRS") ønsker sammen med landets 30 kommunale redningsberedskaber ("de Kommunale Beredskaber") at indgå en rammeaftale om anskaffelse af mobilt dæmningsmateriel i form af fritstående oversvømmelsesbarrierer. Anskaffelsen har primært til formål at understøtte BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers akutte håndtering af klimahændelser, herunder ved varsling om forhøjet vandstand fra bagland såvel som havvand, samt ved indsats i forbindelse med større brande. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal anvendes både selvstændigt i forbindelse med håndteringen af bl.a. klimahændelser, ligesom det skal indgå som supplement til BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers eksisterende opdæmningsmateriel. Materiellet skal kunne anvendes i flere forskellige indsatsscenarier. Det skal for det første kunne etableres hurtigt og fleksibelt over varierende strækninger ved ekstraordinære vandstandsstigninger, herunder ved akut indsats i baglandet, f.eks. ved søer og åer, samt ved kyster og havne. Det skal for det andet kunne benyttes til beskyttelse af enkeltobjekter, f.eks. kritisk infrastruktur. Det skal for det tredje kunne anvendes som vandreservoir i forbindelse med større brandindsatser, hvor vand anbringes i reservoiret, hvorfra én eller flere pumper fordeler vandet til indsatsområdet. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal have en primær højde svarende til højden på BRS' eksisterende og mest anvendte opdæmningsmateriel. Da de lokale beredskabers risikovurderinger og behov varierer, ønskes der herudover tilbudt opdæmningsmateriel i andre højder, som muliggør tilpasning til områder med behov for lavere eller højere opdæmning. Det er væsentligt, at materiellet tillader hurtig, let og effektiv transport, etablering og nedtagning, herunder at håndteringen kan ske med et minimum af ressourcer og på en arbejdsmiljømæssigt forsvarlig måde. Materiellet forudsættes at kunne benyttes flere gange. Materiellet vil blive oplagret på lager og transporteret til indsatsområderne via lastbil. Under indsættelse skal materiellet kunne håndteres ved håndkraft, herunder aflæsses, opsættes, nedtages og læsses, af et minimalt mandskab. Rammeaftalen har en varighed af 4 år fra underskrift.
